The structure of composition K12Ca4Br12 (reduced formula K3CaBr3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments throughout: Ca and K centers each coordinate six Br neighbors, while Br centers coordinate to three Ca and three K neighbors, with all neighbor distances near 3.14 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Br octahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between K octahedra, and edge-sharing between Ca and K octahedra.
